name: Lu Career Radar - Discover, Score, Store

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json;
const list = Array.isArray(input) ? input : (input.jobs || input.data || input.results || []);
return list.map(j => ({json:{
  company: j.company || j.company_name || '',
  title: j.title || j.job_title || '',
  city: j.city || j.location?.city || '',
  country: j.country || j.location?.country || '',
  geography: j.geography || '',
  currency: j.currency || '',
  salaryMin: j.salaryMin ?? j.salary_min ?? 0,
  salaryMax: j.salaryMax ?? j.salary_max ?? 0,
  bonusPct: j.bonusPct ?? j.bonus_pct ?? 0,
  industry: j.industry || '',
  url: j.url || j.job_url || '',
  source: j.source || 'job-feed',
  jobDescription: j.jobDescription || j.description || j.job_description || ''
}})).filter(x => x.json.company && x.json.title);

const b = $json.body || $json;
const rows = Array.isArray(b) ? b : (b.jobs || b.rows || [b]);
return rows.map(j => ({json:{
  company: j.company || j.company_name || '',
  title: j.title || j.job_title || '',
  city: j.city || '',
  country: j.country || '',
  geography: j.geography || '',
  currency: j.currency || '',
  salaryMin: j.salaryMin ?? j.salary_min ?? 0,
  salaryMax: j.salaryMax ?? j.salary_max ?? 0,
  bonusPct: j.bonusPct ?? j.bonus_pct ?? 0,
  industry: j.industry || '',
  url: j.url || j.job_url || '',
  source: j.source || 'clay',
  jobDescription: j.jobDescription || j.description || j.job_description || ''
}})).filter(x => x.json.company && x.json.title);
